description: This file implements an Android Service named MessagingService that manages messaging notifications, including creating and sending notifications with actions for marking messages as read and replying via voice or text. It handles incoming messages via a Messenger, creates PendingIntents, and constructs notifications supporting Android Car extensions and remote input.

classes.name: MessagingService
classes.description: An Android Service that handles messaging notifications, acceptance of incoming messages via Messenger, and creation of rich notifications with reply and read actions, including support for car extensions.

classes.name: MessagingService.IncomingHandler
classes.description: A static Handler class that processes messages received by MessagingService, specifically triggering notification sending.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the IBinder for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: getMessageReadIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent triggered when a message is marked as read.

methods.name: getMessageReplyIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent triggered when a voice reply is received.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Builds and sends notifications for multiple conversations.

methods.name: sendNotificationForConversation
methods.description: Constructs and posts a notification for a single conversation, with reply and read actions.
